paper.title: Fortran 77 Subroutines for the Solution of Skew-Hamiltonian/Hamiltonian Eigenproblems (Algorithm 961, SHHEIG)
paper.venue: ACM Transactions on Mathematical Software 42(3), Article 24 (2016), per the queue entry; article not fetched

field: numerics (linear algebra: skew-Hamiltonian/Hamiltonian pencils, deflating subspaces)
stack: Fortran 77 (netlib CALGO 961.zip, SHHEIG release 1.0 sources, unedited; gfortran 16 from conda-forge, -fdefault-integer-8)

claim.text: The ALPHAR, ALPHAI and BETA vectors printed by the shipped DGHFDF example driver (TDGHFDF.f, input examples/DGHFDF.dat: real 8 by 8 skew-Hamiltonian/Hamiltonian pencil) agree elementwise with the shipped reference output examples/DGHFDF.res within absolute tolerance 1e-3 (registered before any run; the claim is the code's own reference output, not a value from the paper). Z, Q and U are not part of the claim.
claim.determinism: deterministic (fixed input in DGHFDF.dat; no random numbers)

attempt: G1 original attempt: the authors' tree as shipped (make.inc unedited) builds the library (make lib exit 0) but the DGHFDF example fails to link: 'cannot find ../libs/blas64.a' (SLICOT, LAPACK, BLAS and lpkaux are not in the archive). Patch (build-only, no source file touched): SLICOT 5.9.1 built as libslicot64.a with cmake -DSLICOT_INTEGER8=ON against the Ubuntu noble ILP64 LAPACK/BLAS 3.12.0 (liblapack64/libblas64), and those libraries copied to Src/libs/ where make.inc looks. Rebuilt and run: the four ALPHAR, four ALPHAI and four BETA values agree with examples/DGHFDF.res within 1e-3 (every printed value matches the reference at its four printed decimals, so the largest difference is 0). The Z and deflating-subspace matrices differ in some signs, which the readme allows and which are outside the claim. G3: a second pass from a clean unpack (the same placed libraries and commands) gives a byte-identical DGHFDF.exa.

original_attempt.reason: the example does not link: the dependency libraries (SLICOT, LAPACK, BLAS, lpkaux) that make.inc names under ../libs are not in the archive
